# Setup Checklist

Generated by cpinit. Update this file when the project stack, package manager, or validation contract changes.

## Detected stack

- Node.js 22
- TypeScript
- npm with a committed lockfile
- GitHub Actions for CI and scheduled refresh execution

## First setup and validation commands

- Install: `npm ci`
- Test: `npm test`
- Type-check: `npm run typecheck`
- Build: `npm run build`
- Dependency audit: `npm audit --audit-level=high`
- Manual refresh: `npm run refresh`
- Scheduled-gate refresh: `npm run refresh -- --scheduled`

## Warnings

- Live refreshes require the documented GitHub `production` environment secrets.
- Keep the existing local automation enabled until manual parity and two scheduled cloud runs pass.
